notes.title: Meat Grinder QOL Update
notes.content:
Small update that allows you to turn off checkpoints to make it easier to have a perfect run. Look in Settings/Gameplay/Meat Grinder Checkpoints

Death in the first chunk of a meat grinder run now does a full reset of deaths, time and pacifiers.

Leaderboards are shared with mobile.

Have fun!

notes.title: Introducing Meat Grinder and Forever Forge!
notes.content:
Introducing [b]“Meat Grinder” [/b]which has two ways to experience levels in Super Meat Boy Forever 

[list]
[*][b]"The Daily Grind"[/b] is a randomly generated level that switches out daily. Get to the end as quickly as possible to top the leaderboards. Keep playing to beat your record!
[*][b]"Quick Play"[/b] lets you play a level generated from all the "level chunks" in a chapter. Maybe you'll see something new! 
[/list]
Steam Workshop support has been added! [b]Forever Forge[/b] is now open and waiting for your levels. Our level creation tools are free with Super Meat Boy Forever (launch them from the Steam Library page) and we have a video tutorial for the level here. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bLJ39HrxyiY&t=6302

notes.title: Non-major update.
notes.content: This is an update that fixes a few bugs in the game that were addressed during the development of the mobile version, adjusts some incorrect difficulty ratings, and removes the DLC menu which will be added back once we have DLC ready!
